Fireman Tom Cotton, now stationed at Wimbledon, sends greetings and regrets he has not been able to get to the Hall recently. We are sorry to hear his wife is in hospital and sincerely trust she will soon be back home.
Tom Cotton informs us that his wife was injured when a flying bomb exploded a few yards away from her at Aldwych. After five weeks in hospital she is convalescing.
